name: smartsplit
description: SmartSplit - distributed, service-oriented group expense splitting system (NADV 744 group assignment)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix services/api-gateway && npm install --prefix services/user-service && npm install --prefix services/expense-service && npm install --prefix services/settlement-service && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n gateway,user,expense,settlement -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev --prefix services/api-gateway" "npm run dev --prefix services/user-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/expense-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/settlement-service"
scripts.start: concurrently -n gateway,user,expense,settlement -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm start --prefix services/api-gateway" "npm start --prefix services/user-service" "npm start --prefix services/expense-service" "npm start --prefix services/settlement-service"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix services/user-service && npm test --prefix services/expense-service && npm test --prefix services/settlement-service && npm test --prefix services/api-gateway
